{{Infobox auto}}
A '''mud kiln''' is a block that fires clay, sand and stone. It replaces the {{MCW|Smoker|smoker}} and works like one, with fuel, but instead of cooking food it is the pack's early kiln: it makes [[brick]]s, glass, terracotta and smooth stone before the player has an [[oven]] or a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]]. Most food put in it comes out charred.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The mud kiln needs 4 mud bricks, 2 packed mud and a [[kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/mudkiln.json}}</ref> The vanilla smoker recipe is removed. Crafting one grants the advancement ''Ancient Technology''.

Packed mud can be made from mud and [[straw]], or from dirt and short dry grass, so a mud kiln is reachable with only [[kindling]] and a hoe.

== Usage ==
=== Kilning ===
All kiln recipes take 5 seconds, except raw copper (10 seconds) and wet sponges (2.5 seconds).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/brick_from_smoking_clay_ball.json}}</ref>

=== Food ===
The mud kiln cooks only four foods. [[Dough]] becomes [[naan]], and raw meat, fish and potatoes become [[Charred Meat|charred meat]], [[Charred Fish|charred fish]] and [[Charred Potato|charred potato]]es, which heal less than food cooked in an oven or on kindling.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/charred_meat.json}}</ref> See [[Cooking#Charring]].

== Advancements ==
* ''Ancient Technology'': construct a kiln from packed mud and mud bricks.
